description: NTSB aviation accident/incident investigations, plane crashes, by aircraft registration (tail) number or by make/model, optionally filtered by `state`, `year`, or `injury_level` (fatal, serious, minor, none). Returns NTSB number, event date, location, injury level, phase/occurrence, probable cause, findings, and the NTSB docket link for each match. Registration numbers (N-numbers) are reused over time by different aircraft; pass `year` to narrow a registration match to one incarnation when more

injury_level.description: Highest injury level reported for the event: fatal, serious, minor, or none.

registration.description: Aircraft registration / tail number, e.g. "N512SP" (dashes/spacing ignored).

state.description: US state postal abbreviation of the event location, e.g. "CA".

year.description: Limit to events in this calendar year. Required for a common make (e.g. Cessna, Piper) unless `model` is also given.

name: ntsb-investigations__ntsb_search_investigations
